newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Big Russian aluminium plants boost 1996 output.
newsitem.headline: Big Russian aluminium plants boost 1996 output.

text.p: Russia's five biggest primary aluminium smelters raised output in 1996, with Bratsk, the world's biggest smelter, showing a slight rise, a senior Russian metals industry source told Reuters on Thursday.
The source gave the following figures for the five smelters, whose output accounts for over 80 percent of total Russian primary aluminium output --
Russian aluminium producers' group Kontsern Alyuminiy said earlier this month that Russian production in 1996 rose to 2.87 million tonnes.
On that basis, the five smelters in the table accounted for around 84 percent of total output last year.
